CheckTitle: CodeBuild project without for S3 log encryption
Description: S3 log outputs generated by CodeBuild projects are configured without encryption at rest.
Risk: Unencrypted log files stored in S3 could expose build output details and potential environment secrets due to misconfigured or unauthorized access to the destination S3 bucket.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure S3 log encryption is enabled when S3 logging is configured for all CodebUild projects.
